A cell wall is a structural layer that surrounds some cell types , found immediately outside the cell membrane . It can be tough, flexible, and sometimes rigid. Primarily, it provides the cell with structural support, shape, protection, and functions as a selective barrier. [ 1 ] Another vital role of the cell wall is to help the cell withstand osmotic pressure and mechanical stress. Cell walls are found in most prokaryotes , with the exception of mollicute bacteria. Among the eukaryotes , cells walls are prevalent in fungi , algae and plants but absent from animals and many other taxa.
